tldr: Uranus in the 1st house: freedom becomes personal through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
body:
With Uranus in the 1st house, this part of you awakens through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life. Uranus describes freedom, disruption, originality, change, and the need to break from stale patterns. In practice, this brings attention to how you enter the room, respond first, take up space, and let the world meet you.

When this placement is supported, you can meet life with more self-trust and less need to explain yourself first. Uranus can become honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small.

When it is strained, you may become overly focused on how you are seen, or push your body past what it is trying to tell you. The harder pattern can show up as instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point.
gift: honesty, invention, independence, and the courage to change what has become too small expressed through identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
challenge: instability, detachment, rebellion for its own sake, or changing everything to escape one pressure point around identity, body, presence, and the way you meet life.
